question: Estimate the reach of a Swiggy/Zomato 'mega sale' day campaign across Indian tier-1 cities.
idealClarificationQuestions: App-based + email + push + paid social combined? Yes.
1-day mega sale (e.g., Swiggy Maha Saturday, Zomato Sunday Special)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Multi-channel: app users + paid social + earned (organic).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top 8 cities Swiggy/Zomato MAU: ~3 crore each = ~5 crore unique (some overlap).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Push + email + in-app banner reach: ~80% of MAU = ~4 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total mega-sale day reach in Tier 1 cities: ~5-6 crore unique food delivery app users see the campaign.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, actually order on the day: ~25-30% = ~1.5 crore orders peak (vs ~50 lakh normal day in T1).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total mega-sale day reach in Tier 1 cities
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~5-6 crore unique food delivery app users see the campaign.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, actually order on the day
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~25-30% = ~1.5 crore orders peak (vs ~50 lakh normal day in T1).

calculationFlow: Top 8 cities Swiggy/Zomato MAU: ~3 crore each = ~5 crore unique (some overlap).
Push + email + in-app banner reach: ~80% of MAU = ~4 crore.
Paid social ads (Meta + YouTube + push): ~2-3 crore additional unique exposure.
Total mega-sale day reach in Tier 1 cities: ~5-6 crore unique food delivery app users see the campaign.
Of these, actually order on the day: ~25-30% = ~1.5 crore orders peak (vs ~50 lakh normal day in T1).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Of these, actually order on the day: ~25-30% = ~1.5 crore orders peak (vs ~50 lakh normal day in T1).
